common.fixBeforeUse: Fix the fields below before using it:

targets.title: Targets
targets.subtitle: Connect to open the SSM tunnel on the local port.
targets.openChromeOnConnectHint: Opens Chrome as soon as the tunnel is ready, for targets with domains or URLs
targets.openChromeHint: Opens Chrome pointed at the tunnel

profiles.title: AWS profiles
profiles.subtitle: Profiles with the same SSO URL share the same login.
profiles.loginPending: Finish the login in the browser...

env.title: Environment
env.notFoundText: {file} does not exist in the program folder. Create the environment here.
env.invalidJsonTitle: The file is not valid JSON
env.invalidJsonText: Fix {file} and reload, or start over here; the current file is kept as {file}.bak.
env.tunnelsKeepOld: Open tunnels keep the previous settings until they are reconnected.

general.title: Title
general.titleHint: Shown at the top of the sidebar.

profile.name: Name
profile.nameHint: Used to pick the profile in targets.
profile.ssoRegionHint: Also the default region of the targets.

target.name: Name
target.ssmTargetHint: EC2 instance with the SSM Agent, used as the bridge.
target.dnsHostsHint: Separated by spaces. The Chrome opened by the app resolves these domains to the tunnel. Wildcards work, like *.qa.example.com.
target.openUrlsHint: Separated by spaces. Without http(s)://, https:// is used.
target.chromeProfileHint: Empty uses the target name. Targets with the same value share logins and cookies, but should not be open at the same time.

newEnv.title: New environment
newEnv.name: Name
newEnv.nameHint: It will be saved as env.{name}.json in the program folder.
newEnv.nameTaken: An environment with this name already exists
newEnv.renameCurrentHint: env.json is only used while there are no other environments, so it will be renamed to env.{name}.json.
newEnv.renameSameName: Use a name different from the new one

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.subtitle: They apply to every environment and are saved in ssm-helper.json, next to the program.
preferences.languageHint: Changes the language of every screen right away.

palette.builtInLocked: Built-in palette: it cannot be edited or deleted.
palette.activeRemoveWarning: This is the active palette; if you remove it, the app goes back to {palette}.
palette.reservedName: Name reserved for a built-in palette
palette.name: Name

colors.bgDeep: Window background (sets whether the palette is light or dark)
colors.primaryDeep: Text on the main color, when it is light

log.title: Log
log.subtitle: Messages from the SSO login and the tunnels

sso.bannerText: Confirm this code in the browser

privacy.editHint: Show sensitive data (eye icon) to edit
